title: Transfer of the cone density trichotomy from finitely many comparable cone families (parent step 4, abstracted)
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (A : Set (Rn N)) (δ κ : ℝ) (a : Rn N) (X : ℝ → Set (Rn N)) (Z : ι → ℝ → Set (Rn N)) (Ax : Prop) (Ax' : ι → Prop), 0 < κ → (∀ j (s : ℝ), 0 < s → Z j s ⊆ X s) → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → X s ⊆ ⋃ j, Z j (κ * s)) → (∀ j, Ax' j → Ax) → (∀ j, ((∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μ (A ∩ (Z j s ∩ Metric.ball a r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)) ∨ (∀ K : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < ε ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * (r * s) ^ n) ≤ μ (A ∩ (Z j s ∩ Metric.ball a r))) ∨ Ax' j)) → ((∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μ (A ∩ (X s ∩ Metric.ball a r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)) ∨ (∀ K : ℝ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < ε ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < δ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (K * (r * s) ^ n) ≤ μ (A ∩ (X s ∩ Metric.ball a r))) ∨ Ax)
